evals.name: find-postgres-feature
evals.prompt: What features are available for PostgreSQL? I need a database for my app.
evals.expected_output: List of PostgreSQL-related features from official and community catalogs with IDs, descriptions, and configuration options.
assertions: Includes feature IDs in format ghcr.io/...

evals.name: find-python-feature
evals.prompt: Find me a Python feature for my devcontainer. I need Python 3.11.
evals.expected_output: Python feature options with installation instructions for Python 3.11.

evals.name: search-by-capability
evals.prompt: I want to add some development tools to my container. What features exist for linting and code quality?
evals.expected_output: Features related to linting, formatting, and code quality tools.
assertions: Categories or describes tools by purpose
